name: shapes
title: Shapes
description: Basic Tailwind circle and pill atoms for icons, avatars, tags, and compact controls.
useWhen: You need a neutral visual container before adding content or interaction.
avoidWhen: A semantic, interactive control such as a button is needed.
responsiveBehavior: Shapes preserve their compact intrinsic dimensions at every viewport.
accessibility: Use decorative shapes with aria-hidden when they carry no information.
Add an accessible name when a shape becomes interactive.

variants.title: Circle
variants.description: A neutral circular container for initials, icons, or a single compact visual marker.
accessibility: Provide text alternatives when the contained content is meaningful.

variants.title: Pill
variants.description: A small rounded container for a short label, count, or compact supporting value.
accessibility: Keep the text inside the pill visible and meaningful.
